scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore
scripts.build:e2e: VITE_FB_API_KEY=fake VITE_FB_AUTH_DOMAIN=demo-fh.firebaseapp.com VITE_FB_PROJECT_ID=demo-fh VITE_FB_APP_ID=1:1:web:1 VITE_USE_EMULATOR=1 vite build --outDir dist-e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:e2e && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-fh "(vite preview --port 4173 --strictPort --outDir dist-e2e >/dev/null 2>&1 &) && sleep 3 && node tests/e2e.mjs"
